name: U19-2-terminal-ended
steps: const t=document.querySelector('.terminal-screen');if(!t?.textContent.includes('Session ended')||!t.textContent.includes('code 7'))throw Error('Exit missing');if(t.textContent.includes('Reconnect terminal'))throw Error('Reconnect remains');if(!t.querySelector('.terminal-composer textarea')?.disabled)throw Error('Input remains enabled');
